title: No dead time > 2 s during flight, on a measure that can exceed 2 s
why: DISCHARGED 2026-09-16 — deadtime.json now comes from simulateBelt (one serial typist, event-driven clock, measurementResolutionMs 0) over six belts x 3 player speeds x 40 seeds, not from simulateStage's 120 ms tick. The rubric rejects the parallel-clearing harness, rejects a reading equal to its own resolution, and REQUIRES an in-artifact negative control that breached 2000 ms: removing FlightScene.trySpawn:955's empty-board fast path takes the same route to 3738 ms. Controls in tests/unit/simulation/coreLoop.test.ts and tests/unit/gauntlet/coreLoopItems.test.ts. KEPT ONLY UNTIL THE GAUNTLET IS RE-RUN.

title: The retention pipeline reports improvement for a learner who improves, over the whole route
why: DISCHARGED 2026-09-16 — retention.json now measures only words HIT IN MORE THAN ONE STOP (a within-stage repeat is not a delayed re-test), over all six belts rather than three, from simulateBelt. Two controls are run and written into the artifact, and the rubric fails if either stops failing: a learner pinned at the recognition floor must not read as improving, and removing the D21/D23 retention interleave must CUT the re-met word count (88 -> 28 on the same seed, so the engine supplies roughly two thirds of the line and the content pools' overlap supplies the rest). The item is retitled to what the evidence supports. KEPT ONLY UNTIL THE GAUNTLET IS RE-RUN.

title: Silhouettes read when desaturated, measured where the objects are
why: DISCHARGED 2026-09-16 — the check was rewritten and is now RED on the art, which is a real finding, not a false pass. The measure is position-anchored (tests/gauntlet/silhouette.mjs measureSilhouettes): the scene is asked where each rock and the ship are and the desaturated frame is measured there, so nothing adapts and the measurement cannot migrate. Negative control, browser-free and re-runnable: `npx vitest run tests/unit/gauntlet/silhouette.test.ts` — the same vignette drives this measure to 0.000 while the superseded Otsu measure on identical pixels still reports ~0.27. Live capture: a rock reads 0.373 at the top of the frame and 0.0002 (inside 101.1 vs outside 101.1) once it crosses the near-terrain band; see the V-22.4 entry in gauntlet/escalations.md. THIS ENTRY IS KEPT ONLY UNTIL THE GAUNTLET IS RE-RUN, because report.md still carries the old green row; deleting it before then would let a stale PASS read as DONE.
